parameters.text:
=You write short, honest link-outreach e-mails for {{ $json.business_name }} ({{ $json.domain }}). Each goes to the editor of one website. No flattery templates, no fake familiarity, no SEO jargon ("backlink", "DA", "link juice"), no promises you cannot keep.

PAGES WORTH LINKING TO (use only these URLs; if none fits, point to https://{{ $json.domain }}/)
{{ ($json.assets || []).map(a => '- ' + a.kind + ': ' + a.title + ' — ' + a.url).join('\n') || '- homepage: https://' + $json.domain + '/' }}

PROSPECTS
{{ ($json.prospects || []).map(p => '- ' + p.prospect_domain + ' [' + p.type + '] ' + p.detail + (p.source_url ? ' (page: ' + p.source_url + ')' : '')).join('\n') }}

Angle by type:
- lost: their page used to link to us; it seems the link was removed or the page changed. Ask kindly whether it could be restored, give the current URL.
- mention: they mention us without a link. Thank them, ask to make the mention a link to the given URL.
- gap: they link to similar businesses' resources on this topic. Offer our page as a useful addition for their readers, say in one sentence what it adds.
- ai_source: AI assistants cite this site on our topic. Offer expert input (a quote, data, a guest article or a listing) tied to our page.

Rules: subject under 60 characters; body 70-130 words, plain text, one link, sign as "[Your name], {{ $json.business_name }}". Never claim facts about their site you were not given.

Return ONLY JSON: {"drafts": [{"prospect_domain": "", "subject": "", "body": ""}]}

// Copy of each report HTML named index.html for the PDF renderer (Gotenberg requires that exact file name); one item per site.
return $input.all().map(item => { const doc = (item.binary || {}).data; if (!doc) return item; return { json: item.json, binary: { ...(item.binary || {}), html: { ...doc, fileName: 'index.html', mimeType: 'text/html', fileExtension: 'html' } } }; });

parameters.content:
## SEO Agent — Backlink Monitor (v4.5)
**Every Monday 07:30**: a light watch (links lost / new since the last check, spam) that e-mails only when an **important link was lost** or spam arrived; the **first run of each month** is the full report. On demand: *Manual Run* `{ domain | site_id, light?, email?, callback_url? }`; form option "Check my backlinks" / API `mode: backlinks`.
DataForSEO Backlinks ($0.024 per request): summary, lost (`backlinks_status_type: lost`, `last_seen` since the last check), new (`first_seen` since), and on full runs: links to **broken pages** (`is_broken` → 301 suggestion), referring domains, 12-month history, **unlinked brand mentions** (Content Analysis), competitors once (Labs), the **link gap** (`domain_intersection`, `intersection_mode: partial`: links to a competitor, not to you). About $0.10 per site for a light run, $0.25-0.35 for a full one.
Prospects (`seo_link_prospects`; types lost / mention / gap / reclaim + the AI Visibility Tracker's ai_source): merged with the stored pipeline (status kept; Site Admin `prospect` sets contacted / won / rejected), **won** set automatically when the site starts linking, **outreach drafts** by Claude for up to 8 new prospects a month. Snapshot per run → `seo_backlink_snapshots`. Report: e-mail + PDF + `prospects.csv` + `disavow-candidates.txt` (review only) + callback `stage: backlinks`.
